name: Secrets (API keys, passwords, connection strings, certificates) MUST NOT be committed to Git repositories or baked into container images because this prevents immediate compromise of systems and data.
requirementTitle: Secrets (API keys, passwords, connection strings, certificates) MUST NOT be committed to Git repositories or baked into container images because this prevents immediate compromise of systems and data.
requirementDescription: Never store sensitive credentials in source code repositories or inside container images. Store them in a secure secrets-management solution instead.
why: Leaked secrets are exploited in real-time and can enable direct attacker access to our systems and data.
